_comment: Manual corrections on top of the KMZ data. These survive every new release.
The key is always the ONFF number, never the name — names contain typos and duplicates.
Every field is optional and overrides whatever came out of the KMZ.
Fields: name, province, desig, iucn, manager, registration, region.
For references with no polygon in the KMZ you can put a point here:
The order is [longitude, latitude] — GeoJSON order, so lon first. Such a point
always wins over the coordinate from the ONFF index sheet.

ONFF-0002.name: Kalmthoutse Heide
ONFF-0002._why: the KMZ alternates between 'Kalmhoutse heide' and 'Kalmthoutse Heide'

ONFF-0110.name: Fort van Oelegem
ONFF-0110._why: the KMZ contains the typo 'Fort van Oegegem'

ONFF-0599.name: Carrière de l'Alouette
ONFF-0599._why: the KMZ writes "Carriere de 'Alouttel" — two typos

ONFF-0001.name: Hautes Fagnes
ONFF-0001._why: name comes from the filename hautes-fagnes.kmz
